title: SwingGuard: Risk-Conditioned Multi-Agent Swing Trading with Dual-Timescale Governance

claim.summary: SwingGuard runs daily analyst, bull-bear and Portfolio Architect agents conditioned on a System Risk Context that a five-minute Risk Controller maintains through staged diagnosis and persistent risk states, then audits each proposal and caps executed exposure between revisions.

modules.name: Risk-conditioned multi-agent strategy generation
modules.scope_reason: The current risk context enters the analyst, debate and Portfolio Architect stages to bound a long-only target position with entry, stop, take-profit, validity and size parameters, a trading output contract.
evidence_locators: PDF p.3; passage beginning "The Portfolio Architect internally uses"
PDF p.2; passage beginning "Risk-conditioned strategy generation: the current"

modules.name: Five-minute staged risk diagnosis with persistent risk states
modules.scope_reason: Bar-level screening, six-hour accumulation, same-symbol snapshot retrieval and hysteretic NORMAL/ALERT/SURVIVAL/RECOVERY states are defined to output position caps for the traded asset, so the mechanism keeps the trading contract.
evidence_locators: PDF p.3; passage beginning "As summarized in Figure 2"
PDF p.4; passage beginning "NORMAL permits the standard cap"

modules.name: Hard-boundary audit and risk-to-execution trace
modules.scope_reason: The auditor checks long-only direction, size, stop and validity horizon against controller limits, and the trace records each trading proposal through to the executed position.
evidence_locators: PDF p.4; passage beginning "After proposal generation, a hard-boundary"
PDF p.2; passage beginning "Dual-timescale risk governance: daily structural"
